title: Extended States in the Anderson Model
statement: Prove that the Anderson model has purely absolutely continuous spectrum in dimension $\nu\geq 3$, for suitable disorder width $b-a$, in some energy range.

solutions.summary: Claimed by OpenAI. For each fixed d>=3 and each fixed sufficiently small positive disorder, the manuscript claims the nearest-neighbor Anderson operator on Z^d with iid uniform site potentials has a nonzero purely absolutely continuous spectral restriction to an open interval I_d. The interval is independent of disorder strength; the threshold and probability-one event may depend on the fixed parameters. Global pure-ac spectrum and a mobility edge are not claimed.
solutions.body:
Claimed by OpenAI. For each fixed d>=3 and each fixed sufficiently small positive disorder, the manuscript claims the nearest-neighbor Anderson operator on Z^d with iid uniform site potentials has a nonzero purely absolutely continuous spectral restriction to an open interval I_d. The interval is independent of disorder strength; the threshold and probability-one event may depend on the fixed parameters. Global pure-ac spectrum and a mobility edge are not claimed.

Scope relative to this problem: For nearest-neighbor iid uniform site disorder on Z^d,d>=3, the source claims a nonzero purely absolutely continuous spectral restriction on an open interval at each fixed sufficiently small positive disorder. The interval is disorder-independent, but thresholds and probability-one events may depend on fixed parameters. This addresses an ac energy-range assertion, not global pure-ac spectrum, a mobility edge or quantum diffusion.

Manuscript: https://github.com/openai/math/blob/adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a/preprints/Absolutely-Continuous-Spectrum-for-Weak-Disorder-Anderson-Models-in-Dimensions-at-Least-Three-September-23-2026/paper.pdf
